snippet.title: Battleground Cleaner Simulator: Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: When army-sized battles rage in stuff like Game of Thrones, SOMEONE has to clean up the mess afterwards. That's the premise behind Battleground Cleaner Simulator, which tasks you with tidying up after chaotic medieval events like battlefields, taverns, and feasts that leave blood all over the castle, bodies with forks in their eyes, and so, so much more. Wishlist Battleground Cleaner Simulator on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5527820/Battleground_Cleaner_Simulator/
